Bank Account with Overloaded Methods

Problem Statement:
Create a BankAccount class with method overloading to deposit money using either int or double. Compute the total balance after deposits.

Description:
Demonstrates compile-time polymorphism, arithmetic calculation, and method overloading.

Input Format:

initialBalance
numberOfDeposits
deposit1 deposit2 ...

Output Format:

Total Balance: <value>
